function_question: How does nature catch as much sunlight as possible?

opening.text: There was a girl called Tara who lived at the top of a building in a busy city, with a little garden on the roof.
Tara watered her beans and herbs and dreamed of the day they'd grow tall and green.
A new tower went up next door, and its shadow fell across the roof. Tara's plants turned pale and droopy. "They're hungry for light," she said. "How can I catch more sun?"

card.problem: The rooftop garden gets only a little sun and the plants are weak
card.goal: Arrange leaves or panels to catch the most light
card.rules: 10 leaves or panels, and no cutting down anything

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. A new tower casts a shadow over Tara's rooftop garden, and her plants are hungry for light. Can you help her catch every ray? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some engineers already have a spark of an idea for catching light. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Plants can't walk into the sunshine, but they're experts at catching it. Tap each card to meet four light catchers!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which way of spacing the leaves will leave the fewest in shadow?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your leaf plan from above, like a bird looking down!
guide.build_and_test: Build your model with 10 leaves, shine the light and count how many are in full sun!
guide.retry_tip: Engineers never stop at round 1. Change ONE angle and count again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Tara's rooftop garden has grown green and tall, with every leaf and panel spaced like YOURS to share the sun!

quick_check.question: Tara's model has 10 leaves, and 7 of them are in full light. What percentage is that?
quick_check.right: Right! 7 out of 10 is 70 out of 100, so 70%. Can you get it higher?
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. 7 out of 10 is the same as 70 out of 100.

clue_cards.name: Sunflower
clue_cards.trick: Young plants turn their heads to follow the sun across the sky.
clue_cards.does: They face the light all day, then swing back to face east at night.

clue_cards.name: Sunflower seeds
clue_cards.trick: Each seed grows about 137.5° around from the one before.
clue_cards.does: The spiral packs seeds with no gaps, and leaves spaced this way don't shade each other.

clue_cards.name: Ivy
clue_cards.trick: Its leaf stalks grow to different lengths and angles.
clue_cards.does: The leaves fit together like a mosaic and hardly overlap.

clue_cards.name: Forest
clue_cards.trick: It grows in layers, from tall trees down to the floor.
clue_cards.does: Each layer catches light, and shady plants use big thin leaves.

predict.prompt: Full sun or in the shade? Predict first!

items.label: A leaf right underneath another leaf
A leaf turned 137.5° from the one below
The top leaf of a tall tree

predict.explain: A leaf in another leaf's shadow can hardly make food. Turning each leaf by the golden angle means no leaf sits right above another, so they share the light.

lab.title: The shadow puzzle
lab.predict: Build 4 model plants with 6 leaves each. Shine a torch from above. Which one will have the most leaves in full light?
lab.measure: leaves in full light out of 6

tool.name: Mind map
tool.intro: A mind map grows your ideas like a tree, from one big question in the middle. You've met all 5 pieces before. Today you'll use every one of them, like a true mind map legend!

parts.name: Centre
parts.what: Put the big question in the middle.
parts.example: 🚲 "A better bike" goes in the middle.
parts.starter: In the centre of my map I write…

parts.name: Branches
parts.what: Draw lines out to the main topics.
parts.example: 🚲 Branches: faster, safer, easier to carry.
parts.starter: My branches are turn to the light, space out and…

parts.name: Twigs
parts.what: Add smaller ideas to each branch.
parts.example: 🚲 On "safer": bright lights, a bell, reflectors.
parts.starter: On the "space out" branch I add the golden angle and…

parts.name: Pictures
parts.what: Doodle quick icons next to your ideas.
parts.example: 🚲 A tiny lightning bolt next to "faster".
parts.starter: Next to "turn to the light" I'll doodle…

parts.name: Links
parts.what: Join ideas on different branches with a line.
parts.example: 🚲 "Bright lights" links to "ride at night": it helps both!
parts.starter: A line joins the ivy mosaic to…

sketch_checklist: I drew my plan from above and numbered every leaf.
I wrote the angle I turn between leaves.
I marked where the sun comes from.

test.measure: leaves in full light out of 10
test.check_question: Light check: where did your light come from?
check_options: A desk lamp, with an adult

reflection.question: Which nature trick caught the most light for you?
